mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an active monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuations and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate higher future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through earnings contraction.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE 3m change > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in residential sales and financing indicates robust consumer spending momentum that accelerates corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through earnings-driven equity appreciation.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline + RSAFS rise) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL 12m change > 3.0%) triggers imminent monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as discount rates rise faster than earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through supply-side earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained housing starts level above 900,000 units indicates strong residential construction activity that drives consumer confidence and disposable income growth, supporting positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through consumption-led earnings expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when HOUST > 900000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points in the past month signals immediate economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment and short-term equity selling, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns through volatility spikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE 1m change > 0.3pp, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales and financing above 430,000 million dollars indicates elevated consumer spending momentum that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through sustained earnings expansion and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 60% of instances when RSAFS > 430000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
